executionPolicy.scope: all payload objects during stage creation and READY verification
executionPolicy.executableModeMeaning: frozen metadata preservation only; never an execution authorization
prohibitedOperations: execve, execveat, fexecve or any equivalent exec syscall on payload
posix_spawn, system, popen, shell or subprocess invocation of payload
interpreter import, compile, eval or exec of payload source or bytecode
dynamic loader, dlopen, plugin or shared-object loading from payload
Git hook, package lifecycle script or installer execution from payload
systemctl, service-manager, socket or unit activation using payload
runtime-profile, broker, verifier, orchestrator, Node, Python, Git or bwrap invocation from payload
executionPolicy.readyInvariant: any payload execution or attempted execution is STOP and forbids ROOT_OWNED_STAGE_READY

sourceContract.lookup: relative dirfd traversal only; O_NOFOLLOW on every opened component
requiredChecks: no absolute path, dot segment, empty segment or traversal
no symlink, hardlink, special object, xattr, group-writable or world-writable source
every file bytes/rawSha256 and every record mode match

creationContract.directoryCreation: mkdirat under verified root-parent FD; EEXIST is STOP; no reuse
creationContract.fileCreation: openat with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC under verified stage dirfds
creationContract.ownership: every created object must remain uid=0,gid=0
creationContract.ordering: create private directories, write+fsync files, apply exact modes bottom-up, fsync every modified directory
creationContract.closedPayload: exactly the 392 payload records plus root-stage-receipt.json

receipt.serialization: strict I-JSON with duplicate-key rejection; raw UTF-8 bytes equal RFC8785 canonical bytes exactly; no trailing LF
receipt.digestAlgorithm: sha256(raw RFC8785 canonical receipt bytes), recomputed after no-follow re-open and emitted in successOutput
receipt.creation: openat stage FD with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC; write; fsync(receipt FD); fchown root:root; fchmod 0400; fstat; fsync(receipt FD) again to durably commit security-critical metadata; fsync(stage directory FD); no-follow reopen and full receipt validation; any failure STOPs before READY
receipt.fileIdentity: regular file, nlink=1, uid=0, gid=0, mode=0400, 0<size<=8192 and exact canonical byte count

governancePacketCanonicalDigest.x-runtimeEquals: Owner-confirmed RFC8785 canonical digest of this exact governance Packet

receipt.verification: no-follow re-open from verified stage FD; strict parse; exact closed fields/types/values; canonical raw equality; SHA-256, ownership, mode, nlink, size and fstat identity equality

failurePolicy.partialCreation: remove only objects created by this invocation in reverse frozen order after inode/type verification
failurePolicy.successInvariant: without executing any payload, re-open from root-parent FD and reverify complete closed payload, modes, ownership, digests and exact closed canonical receipt before emitting READY
